block_node.block_desc: The block evaluates the performance of a tracking algorithm by computing the optimal subpattern assignment metric between tracks and known truths. The metric is comprised of the localization error, cardinality error, and labeling error components. The individual error components can also be selected as block outputs.

The block evaluates the performance of a tracking algorithm by computing the generalized optimal subpattern assignment metric between tracks and known truths. The metric is comprised of the switching error, localization error, missed target error, and false track error components. The individual error components can also be selected as block outputs.
